name: Gardens and Castle at Kroměříž
description: In the Moravian town of Kroměříž in eastern Czechia, a grand Baroque palace stands beside the River Morava. For centuries it was the main residence of the bishops, and later archbishops, of Olomouc. Its formal gardens are remarkably well preserved, so visitors can still walk through a princely Baroque estate laid out much as it was originally.
